result.topic_en: Bare calculations: a saddle-point type estimate involving logarithms and theta-series expansions, followed by manipulations of the Gamma function (Gauss's Π) via the reflection formula and duplication/multiplication formulas, connected to the functional equation of ζ(s).
result.transcription:
$\log x + x = \alpha + 1$ [?]
$\log r + r\cos\varphi = \alpha$
$\varphi + r\sin\varphi = 0$ [?]
$r = \frac{2-\varphi}{\sin\varphi}$ [?]
$\log(2-\varphi) - \log\sin\varphi + (2-\varphi)\cot\varphi = \alpha$
$-\frac{1}{2-\varphi} - 2\cot\varphi + (2-\varphi)\ldots - 1 - \cot\varphi^2$ [?]
$(2-\varphi) - \frac{1}{2-\varphi} = (1+\cot\varphi)^2$
$= \cot\frac{\varphi}{2}^2$ \quad $\frac{1+\cos\varphi}{\sin\varphi} = \frac{2\cos\frac{\varphi}{2}^2}{2\sin\frac{\varphi}{2}\cos\frac{\varphi}{2}} = \cot\frac{\varphi}{2}$

$\log q = -\pi\frac{K'}{K}$
$\sqrt{k} = 2q^{\frac14}\ldots$
$kk = 16q\ldots$
$n.\frac{(\log\frac{K'}{K})^n (\frac{t}{2})^n}{\Pi(n)}$ [?]
$16 e^{-\pi\frac{K'}{K}} (\frac{K'}{K})^{\frac94} 2.2 \frac{(\log\frac{K'}{K})^n}{\Pi(n)} (\frac{t}{2})^n \partial\log\frac{K'}{K}$ [?]

$-\pi s + \frac94\log s + n\log\log s$

$-\pi + \frac{9}{4s} + n\frac{1}{s\log s} = 0$

[-$\pi s\log s + \frac{9\log s}{4} + n = 0$-]

$(\pi s - \frac94)\log s = n$

$\sqrt{\frac{2K}{\pi}} =$ [-$1 + 2q + \ldots$-] $2\Sigma q^{nn}$
$\Sigma nn q^{nn}(-\log q)^{\frac32}$ [?]
$(\Sigma n^4 q^{nn}(-\log q)^{\frac32} - \frac32 nn(-\log q)^{\frac12})(-\log q)^{\frac34}$ [?]

$\xi(s)\,\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1) =$ [-$\xi(1-s)\,\pi^{-\frac{1-s}{2}}\Pi(\frac{-1-s}{2})$-] [?]

$\Pi(s-1)\Pi(-s) = \frac{\pi}{\sin s\pi}$

[-$\Pi$-]
$\Pi(s-\frac12)\Pi(-\frac12-s) = \frac{\pi}{\cos s\pi}$

[-$\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-\frac34)$-] [?] \quad $\frac{2^s\,\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-\frac14)\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-\frac34)}{\Pi(s-\frac12)} = (2\pi)^{\frac12}$ \quad $\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-\frac14)\Pi(-\frac{s}{2}-\frac34) = \frac{\pi}{\sin(\frac14-\frac{s}{2})\pi}$

[-$\Pi$-]

$\frac{\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-\frac34)}{\Pi(-\frac{s}{2}-\frac34)} = \frac{2^{-s}(2\pi)^{\frac12}\,\Pi(s-\frac12)\,\sin(\frac14-\frac{s}{2})\pi}{\pi}$

$\frac{4^{4s}\,\Pi(s-\frac14)\Pi(s-\frac12)\Pi(s-\frac34)\,\Pi s}{\Pi 4s} = \frac{(2\pi)^{\frac32}}{2}$ [?]

$\frac{2^{2s}\,\Pi(s)\,\Pi(s-\frac12)}{\Pi 2s} = \frac{2\pi^{\frac12}}{\sqrt2}$ [?]

$\frac{2^{6s}\,\Pi 2s\,\Pi(s-\frac14)\Pi(s-\frac34)}{\Pi 4s} = \frac{2\pi}{\sqrt2}$

$\frac{2^{4s}\,\Pi(2s)\,\Pi(2s-\frac12)}{\Pi 4s} = \frac{(2\pi)^{\frac12}}{\sqrt2}$

$\frac{2^{2s}\,\Pi(s-\frac14)\Pi(s-\frac34)}{\Pi(2s-\frac12)} = (2\pi)^{\frac12}$

methods.what: Derivation relating cot(φ/2) to (1+cos φ)/sin φ via half-angle formulas
Saddle-point / maximum condition: derivative of exponent set to zero
Quotient of Gamma values from duplication and reflection
Duplication formula applied to Π(2s) and Π(2s-1/2)
Functional-equation form of ζ (xi) with Gamma factor
